ptr.note: Call-scoped borrow; no caller pointer retained. Context storage and children remain C-owned; byte buffers have the scalar length/count or backend digest size.

Output of exactly size bytes: min(size, digest size) digest bytes, then zero padding up to size. size is the caller's upper bound and may be any int up to the buffer length; a caller holding a buffer longer than INT_MAX passes INT_MAX and pads the rest itself. size 0 writes nothing (memcpy of 0 bytes needs a valid pointer). The context is finalized even then. No retention.
